original_test_intent: Measure vendor-defined NVLink transport bandwidth across all required GPU/NVSwitch paths and directions and verify per-path plus aggregate performance thresholds while retaining complete fabric and SUT health.
original_method: Pin harness/module/config, stable GPU/NVSwitch/port topology and expected links; capture link state/error baseline; define source/destination pairs, direction, payload, concurrency, warmup, duration/repetitions, units/statistics and thresholds; drain jobs; run under full-fabric telemetry/watchdog; retain raw samples and compare per path/aggregate; stop traffic and revalidate every link/device/error/usability.
manual_activity: NVLink/performance owner supplies complete topology and traffic/oracle, approves long multi-device workload and recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Complete stable GPU/NVSwitch/port/link map and expected count/state
Per-path/aggregate units/statistic/numeric thresholds and SKU policy
Dedicated job drain, telemetry, watchdog, OOB and recovery
safety_requirements: No floating harness or generic copy substitution
Verify complete fabric and target pairs before load
Abort on link degradation, reset, XID/error or unsafe telemetry
Stop all traffic, preserve first failure and never clear or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Compute defined per-path/aggregate statistics with raw evidence
Cleanup/recover and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve harness, traffic matrix and thresholds/statistics
Approve SKU exception/recovery and interpret asymmetry

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Report raw trials and approved statistics per directed GPU-switch/GPU path plus aggregate concurrency, tied to topology identity, link state, utilization and errors.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes pass quantitative and exposes asymmetric or missing paths hidden by aggregate throughput.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Topology enumeration or application performance cannot substitute for controlled fabric bandwidth measurements.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent aggregate traffic may saturate shared switch resources; per-path and aggregate thresholds require separate approved expectations.

Per-path and aggregate calculations, link utilization/state and timestamps
GPU/NVSwitch power/thermal/error/BMC deltas and abort/cleanup record
Post-fabric health/usability, exception/disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently names NVLink bandwidth FCT; measurement detail is missing but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Harness, topology and bandwidth oracle are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds topology-complete directed measurements and per-path/aggregate quantitative acceptance to the vendor pass result.
independent_technical_reasoning: An aggregate NVLink number can remain high while one link or direction is absent because traffic redistributes through NVSwitch. Per-directed-path measurements expose asymmetry; aggregate concurrency tests shared-fabric behavior separately. Each result must bind to stable ports and link state because enumeration order can change. Raw repetitions and explicit statistics distinguish persistent performance from transient peaks.
